mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen flooring installation take in a normal Denver-area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on material choice, prep work, and product availability. A straightforward kitchen floor replacement may take a few days, while projects that need demolition, leveling, or repairs can take longer because the floor must be ready before new materials go down.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple installs can take a few days, but demolition, leveling, or repairs can extend the timeline. Material availability also affects when the work can start and finish.
